transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining the pre-publication check-in for our catalog. As you all know, we've accepted 'Glass Harbor' for consideration in either the national competition or the panorama program. The current catalog draft lists it at 94 minutes with premiere status still marked for confirmation. I'd like to hear from submissions and technical screening staff on any status or master-file issues before I make the final programming and delivery decision. What are we seeing?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a premiere status issue. I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding your catalog review has not refreshed, so it still shows premiere status as 'for confirmation.' Since national-competition entries must be national premieres, this film would not be eligible for the national competition based on what I found.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94 minutes listed in the catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and hasn't yet been attached to the programming record, which is why the catalog still shows the old runtime.
transcript.speaker: A3
